panels.title: Discuss how a small business could protect itself from cyberattacks (6 marks)
points: Training staff reduces phishing because staff spot fake emails
Anti-malware stops known threats but must be updated
Backups allow recovery from ransomware, but cost money
Conclusion: training is most important because most attacks target people
